title: SRPPF transition: leased warehouse and design forecasts remain delivery inputs
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: NNSA's SRS procurement answers report a leased offsite warehouse of about 225,000 square feet plus an approximately 4.25-acre laydown yard, while anticipating 90-percent drawings by September 30, 2026 and design of all then-anticipated Main Processing Building gloveboxes before contract transition. Denominator: Named transition facilities and forecast deliverables in Amendment 0001 procurement answers; the FY 2027 volume separately reports approved HFTOC CD-2/3 and MPB site-preparation decisions.
key_findings: Finding: NNSA's SRS procurement answers report a leased offsite warehouse of about 225,000 square feet plus an approximately 4.25-acre laydown yard, while anticipating 90-percent drawings by September 30, 2026 and design of all then-anticipated Main Processing Building gloveboxes before contract transition.

Denominator: Named transition facilities and forecast deliverables in Amendment 0001 procurement answers; the FY 2027 volume separately reports approved HFTOC CD-2/3 and MPB site-preparation decisions.
Boundary: Procurement answers are subordinate to the final RFP and amendments.
Boundary: Anticipated drawings, designs, subcontracts, and delivery dates are forecasts, not accepted deliverables.
Boundary: Warehouse capacity and design progress do not establish installed equipment, CD-4, operational acceptance, or pit output.
Next action: Track final contract terms, approved MPB baseline, delivered and installed gloveboxes, completed HFTOC construction, operational acceptance, and attributable production output.
